text: Completed direct neuroimaging frame construction. SpatialAxes derives complete axis identity from exact locus owner/domain records and volume or surface geometry. LocusFrames, VolumeFrames, and SurfaceFrames emit heterogeneous MeasurementFrame values for regions, selections, parcellations, atlas parcels, labels, and compact locus4s searchlights; Region and searchlight remain builders/renditions, not core cases. Searchlight rendition retains center and scatter order. SpatialFramesSuite passes 9/9 on both JVM and Scala.js, covering exact identity, declared ordering, empty/singleton/sparse centers, self-membership via CenteredNeighborhoodSystem, equal-size foreign owner rejection, atlas paths, and direct EvidenceTable composition. No FeatureSet or FeatureSetPlan remains in mvpa-spatial.
